title: catalyst user add, remove, modify, assign-role
description: What a user verb prints with `--json`: the user's record as `IAM/users/users.json` now holds it (catalyst >= 0.97.0 describes it). `user modify` may have added a field of its own.

active.description: False once removed: a user is deactivated, never deleted.

userid.description: The 8-character suffix of every ID the user signs.
